description: Food pantry inventory and distribution tracker for small volunteer-run pantries: log donations (with best-by dates) and distributions on a tablet, automatic stock levels, low-stock flags, a printable 'use these first' list sorted soonest-first plus a separate 'past its date, pull these' list with configurable cutoffs, household ID or initials only, backup/restore, CSV export. Later phases: new vs returning households, monthly grant report, shared-file merge.

config_schema.org: string, pantry name shown at top (edited inside the app)
config_schema.soonDays: number, 'use first' window in days (default 30, edited inside the app)
config_schema.graceDays: number, extra days after the best-by date before food counts as past (default 0)
